want: to add, rename, and remove the accounts I track from Settings, instead of being limited to a fixed hardcoded list
soThat: the app works for accounts and banks it was not originally written for
acceptance: the app ships with the existing BBL, BCA, BCA Credit Card, Mandiri, Mandiri Credit Card, and Investment accounts pre-seeded as defaults, so existing transactions and notification capture keep resolving them unchanged
the Settings screen has a Manage Accounts entry listing every account with its currency
the user can add a custom account with a name and a currency
the user can rename or delete a custom account they added
a default (seeded) account cannot be deleted, since bank notification parsing depends on its fixed id
the Add Transaction form's account picker reflects the current account list instead of a compiled-in enum
